sents.zh: 明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。
sents.en: In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet.
The man who led it was called Zheng He.

sents.zh: 他的船很大，比房子还大。
sents.en: His ships were large — larger than a house.

sents.zh: 船上有很多人，也有很多东西。
sents.en: There were many people on board, and many goods.

sents.zh: 他们带着丝、茶和很多好东西。
sents.en: They carried silk, tea and many fine goods.

sents.zh: 他们从中国出发，向西走。
sents.en: They set out from China and went west.

sents.zh: 有的地方很热，有的地方很远。
sents.en: Some places were very hot, some very far.

sents.zh: 别的国家的人给了他们新的动物。
sents.en: People in other countries gave them new animals.
Zheng He made the voyage seven times in all.
